title: Going deeper: Warn before the change
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Offer real choices, preparation and participation without handing over the adult responsibility.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: use a clear warning and name the final choice
principle: Support transitions with predictable information and follow-through.
nextSentence: The transition time remains. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can use a clear warning and name the final choice.
keyLearning: Support transitions with predictable information and follow-through.
